أنفلق (form VII)
# أَنْفَلِقُ (ʔanfaliqu) /ʔan.fa.li.qu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْفَلَقَ (infalaqa)

# أَنْفَلِقْ (ʔanfaliq) /ʔan.fa.liq/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْفَلَقَ (infalaqa)
